mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month acceleration in nonfarm payrolls above 200k signals stronger household income and consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the subsequent 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of above-200k payroll growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in the Housing Starts Index below 1.2 million units signals weakening residential investment and reduced construction-related earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of sustained HOUST < 1.2 million (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month rise in the Consumer Price Index above 3% signals tighter monetary policy and higher real discount rates, which depresses equity valuations and produces negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of CPIAUCSL > 3% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in the unemployment rate below 3.5% signals labor market overheating and impending policy tightening, which raises discount rates and produces negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of UNRATE < 3.5% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in Real Personal Spending below $1.5 trillion signals weakening consumer demand, which reduces corporate earnings and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of RSAFS < $1.5 trillion (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in the Industrial Production Index below 98 signals contraction in manufacturing output, which reduces earnings for industrial firms and produces negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of INDPRO < 98 (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month acceleration in nonfarm payrolls above 200k combined with a decline in the unemployment rate below 3.5% signals a synchronized labor market tightening, which raises discount rates and produces negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS growth > 200k for 3 months AND UNRATE < 3.5 for 3 months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of PAYEMS > 200k and UNRATE < 3.5% (t-test p > 0.05).
